title: Is This Industry?
description: Well, what do i say, start making machines from hand and than let them make more machines.
body:
Tired of downloading an automation mod and already having infinite ores?

Well... this mod is balanced, it might take a while for you to get infinite ores, so prove me wrong and speed run it.

Anyways, jokes aside, download this mod, experience making factories from makeshift machines to multiblock complex advanced machines. I don't know, you might just like it?
